drink: Shall we go for a drink?
ok: Come on / right then / bye (Belgians say it for everything)
lunch: Shall we have lunch? (dîner is lunch in Belgium)

want: I fancy some chips (goesting, Flemish for craving)

greet: Hi! Are you heading to Schuman too?
Morning! Did the metro behave today?
Hey, nice to meet you, which DG are you in?
reply: All good, thanks, just survived another long meeting.
Great, I finally found a decent flat in Ixelles.
Fine, a bit tired, the tunnels were blocked again.
Not bad, I had the best frites at Flagey.
sunny: Sun's out, Place Lux will be full tonight.
Perfect weather for the Bois de la Cambre.
Lovely day, let's grab a beer on a terrace.
Sun in Brussels, enjoy it while it lasts!
Gorgeous, let's eat outside at Place Sainte-Catherine.
rain: Grey sky, perfect excuse for a waffle.
Bring your umbrella, it's drizzling all day.
Pouring, I'm not cycling up to Ixelles in this.
Wet again, at least the cafés are cosy.
bye: Take care, see you on Thursday!
Bye! À tantôt, as they say here.
busy: Sorry, I'm late for a working group, catch you later!
Running to Gare Centrale, talk soon!
Can't stop, my train to Leuven leaves in ten!
Back to back meetings today, see you!
Busy one, let's catch up over a beer?

reply: Ça va bien, merci, et vous ?
Ça va, hein, on ne se plaint pas.
sunny: Quel beau temps, on en profite !
Il fait bon, on va au Bois de la Cambre ?
Grand soleil, les terrasses sont pleines.
Il fait beau, on mange dehors à midi ?
rain: Temps gris, on reste au café.
Encore de la pluie, on a l'habitude.
busy: Désolé, je suis pressé, à tantôt !
Je vais rater mon tram, à plus !

greet: Hey! Ook op weg naar 't werk?
sunny: Zalig weer, iets drinken op een terras?
De zon schijnt, allez, naar buiten!
Warm vandaag, ik heb goesting in een ijsje.
rain: Wat een regen, neem je paraplu mee.
Weer regen, we zijn het gewoon.
busy: Ik heb een vergadering, tot straks!

touts: Prochain arrêt : De Brouckère. Volgende halte: De Brouckère.
Attention, les portes se ferment. Opgelet, de deuren sluiten.
Bienvenue à bord. Welkom aan boord. Welcome on board.
Allez, les tomates, un euro le kilo !
Ladies and gentlemen, a little music for your morning!
Contrôle, vos titres de transport, s'il vous plaît.
hawkers: Allez, les fraises, deux barquettes cinq euros !
Come on, strawberries, two punnets five euros!
Sea snails in broth! (Brussels street snack)
small_talk: The Montgomery tunnel was closed again this morning.
Flea market at Jeu de Balle on Sunday, want to come?
My landlord answers in French, my neighbour in Dutch, I answer in English.
Place Lux is full of interns every Thursday evening.
The best frites are at Maison Antoine, don't argue.
Boulevard Anspach is so nice since they closed it to cars.
Another strike on the STIB, I'm walking to work.
It rained in the morning, sun at noon, hail at four. Brussels.
Lunch break by the ponds at Flagey, can't beat it.
